Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Sawsan El lethy, and tested by eng Wael Taha 
 at 11 April 2003, 
 revised by Quality Control eng. Adel Abd El Kader El Naggar at EDEP Co. 
 accepted by General Director eng. El Araby Ali Said and approved by Awad Mohamed.Fathi Head sector of Port Said Gas Turbine Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
 and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required,
Wear your safety helmet and safety 
 shoes.
Circuit breaker must be 
 disconnected
All control circuits must be 
 disconnected
Ensure that the CB removable from the metalclad unit
Ensure that the spring of CB 
 discharging
Notes:
Don't work on the breaker or mechanism while the spring are charged unless they 
are secured in that position by the maintenance
Tools and Equipment
Air blower
Complete tool set
Digital voltmeter
Brushes
Sand paper
WD40 spray fluid
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
